summary: Denison Mines Corp. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its interim consolidated financial statements, management's discussion and analysis, and CEO/CFO certifications for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, plus a press release dated November 4, 2026. This is a routine foreign-private-issuer periodic reporting package (the Canadian equivalent of a quarterly report on Form 10-Q), not a special situation. Balance sheet shows roughly C$362.7 million cash, a C$583.0 million convertible notes liability and 905.4 million shares outstanding; no transaction terms are stated. No deal to watch.
